text.tspan: REGIONAL SYNERGY INTERFACES: EXCHANGE, ENTRY GATES AND STOP RULES
These are auditable open interfaces, not confirmed cooperation, funding, data access, procurement or institutional commitments. Each interface activates only after authorization,
responsibility, cost and exit conditions are agreed.
INTERNAL LIFE-LINE LOOP: ZHONGZHIYUAN (FIND FAILURE) → AI ORIGIN (VERIFY PUBLIC VALUE) → DAZHONGSI (VERIFY CONTINUITY) → EVIDENCE RETURNS

COMMON STOP RULE: without verifiable authorization, minimum data, named responsibility, cost/maintenance, complaint and exit mechanisms, the interface remains NOT ACTIVATED.

svg.text: BEIWEI / BFSU-RELATED COMMUNITIES | Multilingual public service, youth volunteers, community feedback, accessibility walks | Issue a community task brief from the AI Origin station; exchange only anonymized problem lists and public service information. | Evidence: named by the taskbook; boundary and counterpart remain unconfirmed. | Suggested owner: community partner + public service seats. No collection, publication or siting without authorization.

FUTURE SCIENCE CITY | Energy AI, life-health research and campus continuity testing methods | Publish reproducible protocols from Zhongzhiyuan; counterparts may voluntarily contribute interface samples or failure cases under a separate agreement. | Evidence: regional-synergy direction only; no project, budget or data commitment. | Suggested owner: technology-safety seat. No connection before data, procurement and safety review.

HUAIROU SCIENCE CITY | Basic research, major-facility resilience, trusted measurement and verification | Use joint “question-method-evidence” research interfaces; do not duplicate major scientific facilities inside the corridor. | Evidence: regional-synergy direction; specific institutions and studies remain unconfirmed. | Suggested owner: independent observer + professional review. Never portray a research link as signed.

BEIJING E-TOWN / YIZHUANG | Embodied-AI hardware, manufacturing tests, repair and supply-chain feedback | The south station can export bounded scenarios and failure logs; E-Town may return device improvement and maintenance evidence under a separate agreement. | Evidence: algorithm/scenario-manufacturing complementarity hypothesis; no procurement or attraction decision. | Suggested owner: operations + safety seats. No public-road operation before road, insurance, service and liability clearance.

BEIJING-TIANJIN-HEBEI / ZHANGJIAKOU | Green compute, disruption-response experience, standards interoperability and talent exchange | Maintain an auditable compute/service-continuity interface list at Dazhongsi, limited to service levels and recovery evidence. | Evidence: corridor-synergy concept; cross-region governance, energy and network protocols remain unconfirmed. | Suggested owner: standards/compliance seat. No land, investment or construction assignment outside the design scope.
